personality_one_liner: A professional, fast, and distraction-free exam preparation environment.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for long Devanagari and English question texts. Clear touch targets. Stick to systematic multiples.

do's: Avoid glassmorphism to prioritize absolute text legibility and low-end Android device performance.
dont's: No blur over text content, no heavy glass headers.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard overview providing quick resume access to active study sessions, readiness metrics, and clear exam category cards.

states.loading: Centered spinner with a subtle brand tint
states.empty: Illustration of a student studying, encouraging the user to select an exam category
states.error: Readable 'Unable to load dashboard' message with a primary Retry CTA

screens.layout: Top section: User greeting and daily streak (gamification). Middle: 'Resume Study' / active sessions. Bottom grid: Clear exam category cards (Bank, SSC, Railway) spanning screen width with safe touch areas.

screens.name: PracticeModeSelection
screens.purpose: Screen to select practice type (PYQ, Mock, Custom) and chapters via multi-select.

states.empty: No chapters available for the selected exam
states.error: Error fetching chapters with Retry button

screens.layout: Vertical list of practice modes at the top. Below, an expandable accordion or checklist for multi-select chapter picking. Sticky 'Start Practice' primary CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: QuizEngine
screens.purpose: Core exam taking experience. Distraction-free, timer-led, with bilingual toggle.

states.error: Failed to load questions. Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Global bottom tabs are hidden. Top slim context bar: Timer, Question Progress (e.g., 5/30), and Bilingual toggle icon. Main body: Scrollable Question text with 4 distinct option cards. Options should highlight on selection (Subtle gold outline). Bottom fixed bar: Previous, Next, and 'Mark for Review' button. 'Question Palette' accessible via a Bottom Sheet to jump between questions.

screens.name: QuizResult
screens.purpose: Analytics summary immediately following test submission.
screens.layout: Hero section: Circular score ring with accuracy and time taken metrics. Below: Tabular breakdown of Correct, Incorrect, and Unattempted. Sticky 'Review Solutions' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: ReviewMode
screens.purpose: Detailed solution view comparing user answers to correct ones.
screens.layout: Similar to QuizEngine but read-only. Options show green for correct, red for incorrect user choice. Below options: A 'Detailed Solution' card with comprehensive text and source info.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User management, settings, performance history, and bookmarked questions.
screens.layout: Top: Avatar and Name. List items for 'Test History', 'Bookmarks', 'Language Preference', and 'Sign Out'.

screens.name: AdminDashboard
screens.purpose: Private area for managing exams, bulk CSV uploads, and question CRUD.
screens.layout: Stat cards overview. List of Exam Categories. Floating Action Button (FAB) to 'Add New Question' or 'Upload CSV'. Use standard utility list-views.

hero_background.alt: Abstract navy blue and gold textured background

study_illustration.alt: Student studying and preparing for exams

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Absolute Legibility: Use `Hind` font with generous line-heights to support Devanagari scripts flawlessly without cropping top/bottom matras.

Brand Compliance: Use the Navy Blue (#0B152A) as the dominant primary brand/surfaceInverse color and pure White for the main background. Use Gold (#D4AF37) exclusively for accents like selected state outlines, badges, and premium indications.
Quiz Engine Layout: Ensure the Quiz screen hides global navigation (bottom tabs) and replaces it with a slim, context-aware header (Timer, Title, Progress, Bilingual Toggle).

Question Palette: Implement a Bottom Sheet (`@gorhom/bottom-sheet`) in the Quiz Engine for the Question Palette, allowing users to jump between questions, view answered/unanswered/marked-for-review status at a glance.
Disable Glassmorphism: This app targets extreme utility and potentially low-end Android devices. Stick to solid `surfaceSecondary` and `surfaceTertiary` with shadow tier 1 instead of expensive blurs.
Sticky Primary CTAs: Always use sticky bottom CTAs in a `KeyboardAvoidingView` or outside scroll views for major actions (Start Practice, Submit Test, Save Profile).
Haptics: Provide light haptic feedback on MCQ option selection, next/prev navigation, and a success haptic on test submission.
